Star Soft Enterprise v4.0.63 Release Notes (19-Nov-2026 09:40 AM):
- Upgraded Browser Web Client POS Billing to match Main Desktop .exe layout 1:1 (removed static product grid, placed Mobile No first with live DB auto-fill for Name/Address/GSTIN/Tier, floating barcode/item autocomplete on demand, 13-column Desktop invoice grid, and Right Summary & Checkout Dock), added collapsible Left Sidebar toggle, and modernized Enterprise Glass UI.
